historical_references.reference: Bhagya was a name given to the goddess Lakshmi during the Gupta Empire in ancient India. She was worshipped as the goddess of good fortune, prosperity and wealth.
Another reference to the name Bhagya is found in ancient Hindu scriptures where it is mentioned as the name of a celestial nymph who was a companion of the god Indra.
